phase_name: Baseline, safety audit, and live re-triage harness

objectives.description: Re-run literature-combining-audit.sh corpus-wide, produce current residual ledger, reconcile against 824-entry baseline
objectives.note: Re-derived 819 repairable entries via literature-repair-combining.sh --dir <d> --ledger-json over all 60 PDF+markdown directories; category-by-category counts identical to the 403 baseline (ambiguous_anchor 428, anchor_not_found 286, unrecognized_gap 69, overlapping_edit 17, unmapped_base_char 13, narrow_failed 6). Carried forward the 5 non-detector note entries from the 403 ledger unchanged. Total 824, zero drift.

objectives.description: Write re-triage helper (jq recipe) for category x document x base_char counts
objectives.note: Standalone script, not part of file_scope's four deployed .claude/scripts files -- lives in the task directory since it's task-local tooling, reused verbatim by later phases per the plan.

objectives.description: Audit literature-repair-combining.sh against each stated non-negotiable
objectives.note: backup-first+sha256 manifest: present (backup_file()/record_manifest()). Sub-span-only edit regions: present (_find_sub_spans, mandatory narrowing for every group including singletons). Per-edit size cap: present (span_len>6 refused as edit_too_large). Whole-file circuit breaker: present but PRE-WRITE and word-count-only -- this is the confirmed gap, closed by objective 4. --dry-run default: present (MODE defaults to dry-run). Idempotence: present by design, verified empirically in objective 5. Refuse-rather-than-guess: present throughout (overlapping_edit/narrow_failed/unmapped_base_char/edit_too_large/sanity_check_failed all refuse rather than guess).

objectives.description: Add post-write per-file verification (word count AND byte delta) against backup, with automatic rollback
objectives.note: Added word_count() helper, original_by_file/accepted_by_file tracking dicts, and a post-write verification block in the --write loop: re-reads both the just-written file and its backup fresh from disk, requires an EXACT match on word delta, byte delta, written-content-matches-intended, and backup-matches-pre-edit-text; any mismatch triggers atomic_write of the backup bytes back over the corrupted write and records a post_write_rollback residual entry per affected occurrence. Added a documented, env-var-gated test-only corruption hook (LITERATURE_REPAIR_TEST_INJECT_CORRUPTION=1) to allow empirical proof of the rollback path without needing to hand-craft a broken engine build.

objectives.description: Verify literature-convert.sh --self-test passes as regression baseline

objectives.note: Two proofs: (a) scratch-copy end-to-end test (source.pdf + testdoc.md built with a real PyMuPDF-extracted combining mark + a control_char-corrupted markdown occurrence, entirely outside the real corpus, deleted after use): normal --write repaired 1 occurrence with 0 rolled back, then re-running --write over the now-repaired directory proposed 0 rewrites; a corruption-injection run (LITERATURE_REPAIR_TEST_INJECT_CORRUPTION=1) proved the post-write verification catches the induced mismatch and the rollback restores byte-identical original content (diff confirmed identical). (b) Real-corpus --dry-run over four of task 403's already-repaired directories (courcoubetis_1992, schwoon_esparza_2005, bacon_2018_broadest-necessity, yan_2008) all proposed 0 rewrites.

deviations.description: Plan's Rollback/Contingency section requires copying a tooling script's current version alongside it BEFORE modifying it, since .claude/ is git-ignored and unrecoverable via git.
deviations.reason: The literature-repair-combining.sh edit (post-write verification + rollback) was made before a pre-edit copy was saved. Corrected retroactively: the exact pre-edit content (captured via an earlier Read of the file in this same session) was written to specs/404_complete_combining_negation_repair/tooling-backups/literature-repair-combining.sh.pre-phase1 and diffed against the edited file to confirm it reconstructs the true prior state (diff shows only the intended additions, nothing else). All Phase 2+ tooling edits will snapshot BEFORE editing, not after.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — pre-edit backup taken retroactively rather than before the edit; verified correct via diff)*
